risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively detailed, with clear discussion of earnings, balance-sheet repositioning, funding actions, loan growth, and credit metrics. Risk tone is cautiously positive due to improved non-accrual and charge-off ratios, although lower profitability, restructuring activity, reliance on strategic initiatives, and pending credit-loss methodology changes warrant attention. Boilerplate qualification language and the truncated ending modestly limit transparency.
